en.cyber_hint: When enabled, locally block an upstream cyber_policy hit for the TTL only when an explicit session ID is available. Different sessions on the same API key remain isolated. Requests without a session ID are still evaluated upstream; IP, client type, cache keys and history length never identify a blocked session.

zh.cyber_hint: 开启后，仅对携带明确会话 ID 且被上游网络安全策略(cyber_policy)拦截的会话，在 TTL 内执行本地屏蔽。同 Key 的不同会话互不影响。缺少会话 ID 时仍由上游审核，不根据 IP、客户端类型、缓存 key 或历史长度推断封锁。
